payload.query:
query catalogCategories($showAll: Boolean, $categoryId: String) {
  catalogCategories(showAll: $showAll, categoryId: $categoryId) {
    ...catalogCategoryFields
  }
}

fragment catalogCategoryFields on Category {
  id
  parentId
  parentCode
  name
  shortDescription
  description
  fullDescription
  image
  lottie
  imageOffsetX
  imageOffsetY
  imageScale
  color
  weight
  code
  size
  type
  availabilityType
  tags
  classId
  subjectId
  coursesObjectIds
  externalMaterial
  hidden
  isActive
  practiceId
  durationMinutes
  validFromDate
  validToDate
  practiceId
  bannerComponent
  updatedAt
  educont
  educontOnly
  iconUrl
  educontCourses {
    externalId
    label
    link
  }
  randomizedContent {
    classId
    subjectId
    taskQuantity
  }
  showKeys
  teacherThemeGroupMode
  eor
  isPurchased
  tariffTitle
}
